QuestInfo.name: Hand of the Family
QuestInfo.0: Find #b#p1012106##k, the most Diligent woman in #b#m100000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012106# wants you to bring her #b#t4000009#s#k so she can share a home cooked meal with you.\n\n#i4000009# #t4000009# #b#c4000009# / 100#k

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Ah, so you heard that I'm the most Diligent person in #m100000000#. How flattering! I think Anna is much more Diligent than me. Of course, when it comes to cooking, I might be a hair better... Hee hee hee.
0.1: Why, I hear you have some Diligence, yourself! Hm... I bet you'd be able to enjoy some of my special cooking. If you can bring me the ingredients, I'll give you a real home-cooked meal!

yes.0: I need #b#t4000009#s#k. If you bring me #b100 #t4000009#s#k, I'll make you #p1012106#'s special Blue Mushroom Pie. You're going to love it!

no.0: Oh, you're not hungry? Come see me when you're ready to eat.

1.0: Oh, #b#t4000009#s#k! Okay, let's get cooking! A little bit of this...a little bit of that... Voila! All done. Would you like a bite?\r\n#L0##b(The blue pie doesn't look very appetizing, but you take a bite anyway.)#l\n#k
1.1: Hee hee! Well? Even Chief Stan loves this dish! I take it from your silence that you're dazzled by the delicious flavors. Hee hee hee!

yes.0: Home cooking isn't difficult. Diligence is important, but the love and care you put into it is even more important.

item.0: Are you still looking for #b#t4000009#s#k? There are of mushrooms all around #m100000000#.
